mapper.select: SELECT item.sku_code, item.quantity, customer_order.id AS order_id, customer_order.order_code, customer_order.status AS order_status, customer_order.total_amount, customer_order.payment_expires_at FROM customer_order customer_order JOIN order_item item ON item.order_id = customer_order.id WHERE customer_order.user_id = #{userId} AND customer_order.request_key = #{requestKey} ORDER BY item.sort_order LIMIT 1

SELECT item.sku_code, item.quantity, customer_order.id AS order_id, customer_order.order_code, customer_order.status AS order_status, customer_order.total_amount, customer_order.payment_expires_at FROM customer_order customer_order JOIN order_item item ON item.order_id = customer_order.id WHERE customer_order.user_id = #{userId} AND customer_order.request_key = #{requestKey} ORDER BY item.sort_order LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT sku.id AS sku_id, sku.sku_code, sku.status AS sku_status, sku.price_amount AS unit_price_amount, stock.id AS stock_id, stock.available_quantity, product.product_code, product.status AS product_status, product.title AS product_title, COALESCE(sku.image_file_id, product.primary_image_file_id) AS snapshot_image_file_id FROM sku JOIN product ON product.id = sku.product_id JOIN stock ON stock.sku_id = sku.id WHERE sku.sku_code = #{skuCode}

SELECT specification.specification_code, specification.name AS specification_name, specification_value.specification_value_code, specification_value.display_name AS specification_value FROM sku_specification_selection selection JOIN product_specification specification ON specification.id = selection.specification_id JOIN product_specification_value specification_value ON specification_value.id = selection.specification_value_id AND specification_value.specification_id = selection.specification_id WHERE selection.sku_id = #{skuId} ORDER BY specification.sort_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_order ( id, order_code, user_id, request_key, status, total_amount, payment_expires_at, version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{orderCode}, #{userId}, #{requestKey}, #{status}, #{totalAmount}, #{paymentExpiresAt}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )

INSERT INTO order_item ( id, order_id, product_code, sku_code, product_title, specification_snapshot, image_file_id, unit_price_amount, quantity, total_amount, sort_order, created_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{orderId}, #{productCode}, #{skuCode}, #{productTitle}, #{specificationSnapshot}, #{imageFileId}, #{unitPriceAmount}, #{quantity}, #{totalAmount}, #{sortOrder}, #{createdAt} )

INSERT INTO stock_reservation ( id, order_id, order_item_id, sku_id, quantity, status, expires_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{orderId}, #{orderItemId}, #{skuId}, #{quantity}, #{status}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
